verdict.rationale: Edge0 exposes an HTTP API, an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint via `edge0 serve`, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never shows Edge0 publishing or serving its own OpenAI or equivalent spec file. Compatibility with OpenAI's API shape is an adjacent feature, not a first-party machine-readable spec, so it earns no credit here.
